Update the list of books and presentations in the GitLab CI

Source: R/gitlab_ci.R
update_gitlab_ci.Rd

Rewrites the list of the matrix of the job that renders each book and presentation in its own job, in .gitlab-ci.yml:

Usage

update_gitlab_ci(
  path_ci = ".gitlab-ci.yml",
  path_reports = "reports",
  path_presentations = "presentations",
  refs = c("origin/main", "origin/dev"),
  variable = "ITEM",
  fetch = FALSE
)

Arguments

path_ci

Path to the GitLab CI file.

path_reports

Folder containing the book folders.

path_presentations

Folder containing the presentation folders.

refs

Git branches whose books and presentations are added to those of the working directory. A branch that does not exist is ignored (run git fetch to update the remote ones).

variable

Name of the variable of the matrix that has the items.

fetch

Whether to run git fetch origin first, so that the remote branches of refs are up to date.

Value

The items of the list (reports/<book> and presentations/<name>), invisibly.

Details

render:
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - ITEM:
          - reports/01_first_fr
          - presentations/seminar

Only the lines of the items are replaced: the rest of the file, comments included, is kept. The items can be listed on several lines (- item) or on the line of the variable (- ITEM: [a, b]); the result is always the former. The list has the books and presentations of the working directory and of the branches refs (read with git, without checking them out), so that a job of the matrix exists for the items of every branch built by the CI: a job whose item is not on its branch has nothing to render.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
update_gitlab_ci()
} # }
